Authors: Peter J. Chen; Jeffrey A. Hussmann; Jun Yan; Friederike Knipping; Purnima Ravisankar; Pin-Fang Chen; Cidi Chen; James W. Nelson; Gregory A. Newby; Mustafa Sahin; Mark J. Osborn; Jonathan S. Weissman; Britt Adamson; David R. Liu
Title: Enhanced prime editing systems by manipulating cellular determinants of editing outcomes
DNA extraction or genotyping method: two-round PCR amplicon deep sequencing of genomic DNA; CRISPResso2
Main improvement claim: PE4/PE5 co-express MLH1dn to transiently inhibit MMR, improving prime editing efficiency and edit/indel purity; PEmax and epegRNAs further enhance editing.

Authors: Fatwa Adikusuma; Caleb Lushington; Jayshen Arudkumar; Gelshan I. Godahewa; Yu C. J. Chey; Luke Gierus; Sandra Piltz; Ashleigh Geiger; Yatish Jain; Daniel Reti; Laurence O.W. Wilson; Denis C. Bauer; Paul Q. Thomas
Title: Optimized nickase- and nuclease-based prime editing in human and mouse cells
DNA extraction or genotyping method: Roche High Pure PCR Template Preparation Kit; MiSeq amplicon sequencing
Main improvement claim: All-in-one PEA1 with selection achieved PE3 efficiencies up to 95% in HEK293T cells; nuclease PE increased editing initiation but often caused template-derived insertions.

Authors: Seonghyun Lee; Hyunji Lee; Gayoung Baek; Jin-Soo Kim
Title: Precision mitochondrial DNA editing with high-fidelity DddA-derived base editors
DNA extraction or genotyping method: DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit; targeted deep sequencing and whole mitochondrial genome sequencing
Main improvement claim: Interface-engineered split DddAtox halves preserve efficient mtDNA C-to-T editing while largely avoiding collateral off-target mutations.

Authors: Alexis C. Komor; Kevin T. Zhao; Michael S. Packer; Nicole M. Gaudelli; Amanda L. Waterbury; Luke W. Koblan; Y. Bill Kim; Ahmed H. Badran; David R. Liu
Title: Improved base excision repair inhibition and bacteriophage Mu Gam protein yields C:G-to-T:A base editors with higher efficiency and product purity
DNA extraction or genotyping method: PCR amplicon HTS of genomic DNA on Illumina MiSeq
Main improvement claim: BE4 improves C:G-to-T:A editing efficiency and product purity, and Gam fusion reduces indels, generally below 1.5% for BE4-Gam.

Authors: Matthew G. Durrant; Nicholas T. Perry; James J. Pai; Aditya R. Jangid; Januka S. Athukoralage; Masahiro Hiraizumi; John P. McSpedon; April Pawluk; Hiroshi Nishimasu; Silvana Konermann; Patrick D. Hsu
Title: Bridge RNAs direct modular and programmable recombination of target and donor DNA
DNA extraction or genotyping method: flow-cytometry recombination reporter with PCR and Nanopore sequencing confirmation
Main improvement claim: Bridge RNA target- and donor-binding loops can be independently reprogrammed to direct programmable DNA insertion, excision, and inversion.
